attempts.sql: SELECT split_part(file_id, '/', 3) AS sub, 'auto_ontology/server/' || split_part(file_id, '/', 3) AS folder_path, SUM(line_count)::INTEGER AS total_lines FROM code.file_profile WHERE file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/server/%/%' GROUP BY split_part(file_id, '/', 3) HAVING SUM(line_count) > 1000 ORDER BY total_lines DESC

request:
Within auto_ontology/server/, which immediate subfolders contain more than 1,000 lines of Python in total? Count every .py file anywhere inside the subfolder, including its test files and __init__.py; files directly in auto_ontology/server/ itself belong to no subfolder. Return the subfolder's repository-relative path (e.g. auto_ontology/server/chat) and its total line count.

Requested output columns: folder_path (string), total_lines (integer).
explanation: Filters files under auto_ontology/server/ that have at least one further path component (so files directly in server/ are excluded), groups by the immediate subfolder name, sums line counts across all .py files including tests and __init__.py, and keeps subfolders exceeding 1,000 lines.
sql: SELECT split_part(file_id, '/', 3) AS sub, 'auto_ontology/server/' || split_part(file_id, '/', 3) AS folder_path, SUM(line_count)::INTEGER AS total_lines FROM code.file_profile WHERE file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/server/%/%' GROUP BY split_part(file_id, '/', 3) HAVING SUM(line_count) > 1000 ORDER BY total_lines DESC
